Usage: gwt resolve <branch> [flags]

Say how create would obtain a branch: local, remote, ambiguous or absent.

Prints one line:
  local                      a local branch has the name
  remote <ref>               one remote branch has it, such as refs/remotes/origin/x
  ambiguous <ref> <ref>...   several remotes have it
  absent                     none has it; create would fork a new branch
An absent name triggers the fetch create would make, so without --no-fetch this
may contact remotes.

Arguments:
  <branch>          The branch name to look up.

Flags:
      --no-fetch    Decide from cached remote refs, without fetching: a read-only probe.
      --json        Print one JSON object instead of the line.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help        Show context-sensitive help.

JSON:
  One object: kind, one of local, remote, ambiguous or absent; refs, the remote
  refs that have the name, absent for local and absent.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed, or a creation was declined; remove and merged also exit 1 when any target failed,
       after printing every target's result
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
